description: Read the reviewed SEC company catalog, or exact issuer/concept facts with exact decimal strings, fiscal contexts, filing dates, units and immutable acquisition evidence. Publication pins guard current registry coherence; they do not reconstruct a full historical filing snapshot. No inferred quarters or currency conversions.

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key, ten digits with leading zeros (e.g. 0000320193). Omit to list the reviewed companies.

evidence.description: Evidence ID (64 hex characters) from a fact, with cik, to return its acquisition receipt.

publication.description: Publication pin (64 hex characters) from an earlier response, to keep reads on the same registry state.

tag.description: US-GAAP concept, e.g. Assets (default), Revenues, NetIncomeLoss, StockholdersEquity, EarningsPerShareDiluted.

name: get_company_facts
